mapper.sql: select l.access_log_id as "accessLogId", l.information_type as "informationType", l.viewer_user_id as "viewerUserId", u.login_id as "viewerLoginId", coalesce(kps.name, u.login_id) as "viewerName", l.target_scope as "targetScope", l.access_purpose as "accessPurpose", l.purpose_source as "purposeSource", l.access_result as "accessResult", l.request_id as "requestId", l.accessed_at as "accessedAt" from sensitive_information_access_logs l join users u on u.user_id = l.viewer_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no

where.if: and (l.information_type ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or l.target_scope ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or l.access_purpose ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or l.purpose_source ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or l.request_id ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or u.login_id ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%') or kps.name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.filter}, '%'))

mapper.select: order by l.accessed_at desc, l.access_log_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from sensitive_information_access_logs l join users u on u.user_id = l.viewer_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no
